segments.text: It was two in the morning. I could not sleep.
The little red dot on the smoke detector kept blinking.
Except it was blinking in a pattern. Every three seconds. Perfect.
I turned off the lamp and the dot stayed on.
I climbed on a chair and looked closer.
That was not a smoke detector.
